notes.text: DBSCAN eps and min_samples are selected independently per variant from that variant's own k-distance curve; the value is not transferable between the with_ttl and without_ttl feature spaces.
Spectral clustering runs on a nested 5000-row stratified subsample of the 10000-row analysis population, not the full subsample; its metrics are scored on those rows only.

Notebook 01 clusters the full partition in PCA-90 space with silhouette measured on a subsample; this notebook clusters a 10,000-row subsample in the full feature space with silhouette measured on the same rows. Different populations, different spaces -- the comparison is directional evidence, not a controlled experiment.
attack_cat and label are used only for subsample stratification, figure colouring, and post-hoc external validation (ARI, NMI, contingency); they never reach a fit, fit_transform or fit_predict call.

This notebook loads only the cleaned training partition (nids.data.load_clean_partitions().train). No name in its global namespace ever refers to the cleaned testing partition, enforced by an assertion cell.

Every clustering, projection and stability computation runs on the seed-42 stratified subsample (at most 10000 rows, floor 50). The subsample is the analysis population itself, not an estimate of a full-partition quantity.
Any non-finite metric value (infinite or NaN) is registered as the string 'inf', '-inf' or 'nan' instead of a floating-point value, because JSON has no native representation for infinity or NaN.
